data.one_liner: Functional programming essentials for Dart with composition, memoization, and trampolines.
data.what_it_does: Brings functional programming features to Dart through extension methods, including function composition, pipes, constant values, currying, flipping, nullable invocation, stack-safe recursion trampolines, and memoization. It also provides basic functions and a TaggedRecord base class for product and sum types.
use_when: You want to use function composition or pipes to reduce code nesting.
You need stack-safe recursion via trampolines to prevent stack overflow.
You want to memoize function results or use weak memoization for object keys.
avoid_when: You prefer a strictly object-oriented or procedural programming style without functional patterns.
You need a comprehensive state management framework instead of core utility helpers.
strengths: Provides tail call optimization and stack-safe recursion.
Supports up to 9 arguments for extensions like composition and currying.
Includes both strong and weak memoization capabilities.
weaknesses: Can make code harder to read for developers unfamiliar with functional programming idioms.
Using memoization on impure functions leads to unexpected behavior.
